summary: Update the HTTP plug-in registry: oc project <portal-project>, find the build config with oc get buildconfig (e.g. aap-self-service-plugins), then oc start-build <build_config_name> --from-dir=$DYNAMIC_PLUGIN_ROOT_DIR --wait with the new TAR files.
questions: How do I update the portal plug-in registry?
Find the plug-in registry build config name

answer_card.title: Update the portal plug-in registry
answer_card.answer_md:
```bash
oc project <portal-project>
oc get buildconfig            # e.g. aap-self-service-plugins
oc start-build <build_config_name> --from-dir=$DYNAMIC_PLUGIN_ROOT_DIR --wait
```
`$DYNAMIC_PLUGIN_ROOT_DIR` holds the new plug-in TAR files. Then check the files in the new `<build_config_name>-<n>-build` pod and upgrade the Helm chart.
